title: COVID-19 pandemic in South America
summary: The English Wikipedia article "COVID-19 pandemic in South America", at revision 1372456988, opens: "The COVID-19 pandemic was confirmed to have reached South America on 26 February 2020 when Brazil confirmed a case in São Paulo. By 3 April, all countries and territories in South America had recorded at least one case." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q86694744, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "disease outbreak". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
